name: Sword Of Shoguns
review:
Sword Of Shoguns is a 6-reel samurai slot with 5,040 ways, expanding symbols, wilds and free spins.

Thunderkick rates it Very High volatility, with a 25,200x cap and a 96.15% RTP.

Expanding symbols across 5,040 ways can produce big hits when a premium symbol fills several reels. Very high volatility and a 25,200x cap mean this is for patient players.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
